headline: Azure API Management flaw exploited, linked to Norway energy attacks
summary: A security vulnerability in Azure API Management Classic tiers was exploited to steal customers' stored API credentials. Norwegian authorities have linked the flaw to cyberattacks against energy companies. Microsoft says mitigation is in place but is telling admins to investigate possible compromise and rotate secrets.
